messages.subject: For Henrique Braun | Global affairs, sustainability and market stakeholder strategy
messages.body:
Dear Coca-Cola Investor Relations Team,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Henrique Braun, Chief Executive Officer.

The Coca-Cola Company's global system depends on disciplined alignment across governments, bottling partners, communities, water and packaging priorities, and market stakeholders. That intersection closely matches the work I lead today.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate combines government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory, with senior institutional engagement across a complex emerging-market operation.

I would welcome a senior conversation about where this combination of global affairs, sustainability and stakeholder execution might support Coca-Cola's international priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to The Coca-Cola Company.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
